decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-007929 posted on 2026-10-03, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 24 days later. The limit is 120 days. The posted amount is 198780 cents (1987.80 EUR), and it matches the authorised amount on AUTH-008135, also 198780 cents. There is no receipt or quote in the case. The cardholder says they were quoted 1769.15 EUR, which would make a difference of 21865 cents, but they do not have the quote. A cardholder's statement is a claim, not evidence of the agreed amount. Because there is no receipt and the posted amount equals the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. Under amount-no-receipt, the step is to ask the merchant for the receipt or order details.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt, quote or order details for the 1987.80 EUR transaction dated 2026-10-02, showing the amount the cardholder agreed to pay and what it covers.
